source: 2017/TSB Vol 17 No 07 New Lexus Trans Fill Port adapters.pdf
title: Lexus ATF Fill Port Adapters
lead: MOC has developed 2 new transmission adapters to be used on various Lexus vehicles such as the IS 350 and GS 350. These 2 new adapters screw into the transmission-fluid fill port and require the existing Lexus pressure-port adapter to complete the service.
body: Both adapters are used together with the existing Lexus banjo pressure-port adapter (94778) to perform a service.
